source_doc: Market Intelligence for YALai Unlocking Opportunities in AI Cybersecurity.docx
content: YAL.ai can leverage this dynamic by partnering with large enterprises to help them secure their supply chains, creating a channel to a vast network of SMEs who are now compelled by their clients to upgrade their defenses. This transforms the regulatory driver from a direct push on the end-user to a powerful pull from the top of the economic food chain. YAL.ai must have a clear, publicly available data processing agreement that is fully compliant with POPIA.
